scope: Apply the same gates separately to each condition at each history size; six cells of 90 responses. No new results exist.

quality_gates.definition: The requested fact is correct for the intended entity and time, without contradiction of that fact. Semantic equivalents count. Errors and abstentions on these answerable cases fail.

The actual memory context supplied to the final answer contains sufficient meaning to support the requested answer; not just a matching post ID or an assertion by the final model. Errors without delivered context fail.
Answer Satisfaction is true and the answer has no material false or unsupported factual addition.

Responses asserting a wrong entity, relationship, object linkage, or temporal state, divided by all 90 planned responses. Wrong predictions count; safe abstention is an accuracy failure, not a false connection.
Responses containing at least one material false or unsupported factual addition, divided by 90. This flag can overlap a false connection.

performance_target.definition: Nearest-rank P95 over all 90 task durations, retaining first requests, SDK retries, and errors. Report quality and latency gates separately.

validity_requirements.policy: Retain every attempted task and error. Interrupted runs remain incomplete. Do not replace failed answers with successful retries. Usage-dependent metrics remain unavailable if usage is incomplete.

comparison_only_metrics: Graphiti to Full History Token Ratio
Graphiti to Full History Latency Ratio
Graphiti minus Full History Accuracy Difference
Memory Update Error Rate on the declared update subset
comparison_policy: Relative token or latency advantages are research outcomes, not replacements for the quality gates. No mandatory superiority over Full History is assumed. A confidence interval crossing zero is not evidence of equality or non-inferiority.
system_acceptance: Graphiti passes quality at a history size only when all five quality gates pass there. Acceptance across tested scales requires all three sizes to pass separately. Full History is scored identically. Latency is reported as a separate target.
change_policy: Commit the questions, gold, criteria, prompt and source hashes before a future run. Changes after seeing new results require a new version and an explicit reason; preserve the original. These thresholds are proposed after prior ten-case results were known, so this is not a blind preregistration.
